pli-tv-kd5:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
pli-tv-kd5:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro asītiyā gāmasahassesu issariyādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāreti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.1.3: tena kho pana samayena campāyaṃ soṇo nāma koḷivīso seṭṭhiputto sukhumālo hoti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.1.5: atha kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro tāni asītigāmikasahassāni sannipātāpetvā kenacideva karaṇīyena soṇassa koḷivīsassa santike dūtaṃ pāhesi:
pli-tv-kd5:1.2.1: atha kho soṇassa koḷivīsassa mātāpitaro soṇaṃ koḷivīsaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd5:1.2.3: mā kho tvaṃ tāta, soṇa, yena rājā tena pāde abhippasāreyyāsi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.2.6: atha kho soṇaṃ koḷivīsaṃ sivikāya ānesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.2.7: atha kho soṇo koḷivīso yena rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā rājānaṃ māgadhaṃ seniyaṃ bimbisāraṃ abhivādetvā rañño purato pallaṅkena nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.2.8: addasā kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro soṇassa koḷivīsassa pādatalesu lomāni jātāni.
pli-tv-kd5:1.3.1: atha kho rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro tāni asīti gāmikasahassāni diṭṭhadhammike atthe anusāsitvā uyyojesi
pli-tv-kd5:1.3.2: “tumhe khvattha bhaṇe, mayā diṭṭhadhammike atthe anusiṭṭhā.
pli-tv-kd5:1.3.4: so no bhagavā samparāyike atthe anusāsissatī”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.3.5: atha kho tāni asītigāmikasahassāni yena gijjhakūṭo pabbato tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd5:1.4.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā sāgato bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.4.2: atha kho tāni asītigāmikasahassāni yenāyasmā sāgato tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāgataṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd5:1.4.4: sādhu mayaṃ bhante, labheyyāma bhagavantaṃ dassanāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.4.5: tena hi tumhe āyasmanto muhuttaṃ idheva tāva hotha, yāvāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ paṭivedemī”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.5.1: atha kho āyasmā sāgato tesaṃ asītiyā gāmikasahassānaṃ purato pekkhamānānaṃ pāṭikāya nimujjitvā bhagavato purato ummujjitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd5:1.5.2: “imāni bhante, asīti gāmikasahassāni idhūpasaṅkantāni bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
pli-tv-kd5:1.5.4: “tena hi tvaṃ sāgata, vihārapacchāyāyaṃ āsanaṃ paññapehī”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.6.2: kho āyasmā sāgato bhagavato paṭissuṇitvā pīṭhaṃ gahetvā bhagavato purato nimujjitvā tesaṃ asītiyā gāmikasahassānaṃ purato pekkhamānānaṃ pāṭikāya ummujjitvā vihārapacchāyāyaṃ āsanaṃ paññāpesi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.6.3: atha kho bhagavā vihārā nikkhamitvā vihārapacchāyāyaṃ paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.7.1: atha kho tāni asītigāmikasahassāni yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd5:1.7.2: atha kho tāni asītigāmikasahassāni āyasmantaṃyeva sāgataṃ samannāharanti. no tathā bhagavantaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.7.3: atha kho bhagavā tesaṃ asītiyā gāmikasahassānaṃ cetasā ceto parivitakkamaññāya āyasmantaṃ sāgataṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd5:1.7.4: “tena hi tvaṃ sāgata, bhīyyosomattāya uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassehī”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.7.5: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho āyasmā sāgato bhagavato paṭissuṇitvā vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā ākāse antalikkhe caṅkamatipi, tiṭṭhatipi, nisīdatipi, seyyampi kappeti, dhūpāyatipi, pajjalatipi, antaradhāyatipi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.8.1: atha kho āyasmā sāgato ākāse antalikkhe anekavihitaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassetvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd5:1.8.6: atha kho tāni asītigāmikasahassāni “acchariyaṃ vata bho! abbhutaṃ vata bho!
pli-tv-kd5:1.8.7: sāvako hi nāma evaṃ mahiddhiko bhavissati. evaṃ mahānubhāvo, aho nūna satthā”ti bhagavantaṃyeva samannāharanti. no tathā āyasmantaṃ sāgataṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.9.1: atha kho bhagavā tesaṃ asītiyā gāmikasahassānaṃ cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya anupubbīkathaṃ kathesi. seyyathidaṃ –
pli-tv-kd5:1.9.2: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.9.3: yadā te bhagavā aññāsi kallacitte muducitte vinīvaraṇacitte udaggacitte pasannacitte, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā - taṃ pakāsesi,
pli-tv-kd5:1.9.5: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ patigaṇheyya,
pli-tv-kd5:1.9.6: evamevaṃ tesaṃ asītiyā gāmikasahassānaṃ tasmiṃyeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi:
pli-tv-kd5:1.10.1: te diṭṭhadhammā pattadhammā viditadhammā pariyogāḷhadhammā tiṇṇavicikicchā vigatakathaṅkathā vesārajjappattā aparappaccayā satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd5:1.10.3: seyyathāpi bhante, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya
pli-tv-kd5:1.10.6: ete mayaṃ bhante, bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma.
pli-tv-kd5:1.10.8: upāsake no bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupete saraṇaṃ gate”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.11.2: “yathā yathā kho ahaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.11.3: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.11.4: atha kho tāni asīti gāmikasahassāni bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamisuṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.12.1: atha kho soṇo koḷivīso acirapakkantesu tesu asītiyā gāmikasahassesu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.12.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho soṇo koḷivīso bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd5:1.12.3: “yathā yathāhaṃ bhante, bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.12.4: icchāmahaṃ bhante, kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.12.6: alattha kho soṇo koḷivīso bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ. alattha upasampadaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.12.7: acirūpasampanno ca panāyasmā soṇo sītavane viharati.
pli-tv-kd5:1.13.2: caṅkamo lohitena phuṭo hoti seyyathāpi gavāghātanaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.13.3: atha kho āyasmato soṇassa rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd5:1.13.4: “ye kho keci bhagavato sāvakā āraddhaviriyā viharanti, ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro.
pli-tv-kd5:1.13.5: atha ca pana me nānupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
pli-tv-kd5:1.13.6: saṃvijjanti kho pana me kule bhogā.
pli-tv-kd5:1.13.7: sakkā bhoge ca bhuñjituṃ. puññāni ca kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.13.8: yannūnāhaṃ hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjeyyaṃ. puññāni ca kareyya”nti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.14.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato soṇassa cetasā ceto parivitakkamaññāya
pli-tv-kd5:1.14.2: seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya evameva gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito sītavane pāturahosi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.14.3: atha kho bhagavā sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ senāsanacārikaṃ āhiṇḍanto yenāyasmato soṇassa caṅkamo tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-kd5:1.14.4: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmato soṇassa caṅkamaṃ lohitena phuṭṭhaṃ. disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd5:1.14.5: “kassa khvāyaṃ bhikkhave, caṅkamo lohitena phuṭṭho seyyathāpi gavāghātana”nti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.14.6: “āyasmato bhante, soṇassa accāraddhavīriyassa caṅkamato pādā bhijjiṃsu.
pli-tv-kd5:1.14.7: tassāyaṃ caṅkamo lohitena phuṭṭho, seyyathāpi gavāghātana”nti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.1: atha kho bhagavā yenāyasmato soṇassa vihāro tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.2: āyasmāpi kho soṇo bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ soṇaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.4: “nanu te soṇa, rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.5: ‘ye kho keci bhagavato sāvakā accāraddhaviriyā viharanti, ahaṃ tesaṃ aññataro.
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.6: atha ca pana me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.7: saṃvijjanti kho pana me kule bhogā.
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.8: sakkā bhoge ca bhuñjituṃ puññāni ca kātuṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.9: yannūnāhaṃ hīnāyāvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjeyyaṃ. puññāni ca kareyya”’nti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.11: “taṃ kimmaññasi soṇa, kusalo tvaṃ pubbe agārikabhūto vīṇāya tantissare?”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.15.13: “taṃ kimmaññasi soṇa, yadā te vīṇāya tantiyo accāyatā honti, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vā?”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.16.1: “taṃ kimmaññasi soṇa, yadā te vīṇāya tantiyo atisithilā honti, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vā?”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.16.3: “taṃ kimmaññasi, soṇa, yadā te vīṇāya tantiyo neva accāyatā honti nātisithilā, same guṇe patiṭṭhitā, api nu te vīṇā tasmiṃ samaye saravatī vā hoti kammaññā vā?”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.16.5: “evameva kho soṇa, accāraddhaviriyaṃ uddhaccāya saṃvattati. atilīnaviriyaṃ kosajjāya saṃvattati.
pli-tv-kd5:1.17.1: tasmātiha tvaṃ soṇa, viriyasamataṃ adhiṭṭhaha. indriyānañca samataṃ paṭivijjha. tattha ca nimittaṃ gaṇhāhī”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.17.2: “evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.17.3: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ soṇaṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evameva sītavane āyasmato soṇassa pamukhe antarahito gijjhakūṭe pabbate pāturahosi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.18.1: atha kho āyasmā soṇo aparena samayena viriyasamataṃ adhiṭṭhāsi. indriyānañca samataṃ paṭivijjhi. tattha ca nimittaṃ aggahesi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.18.2: atha kho āyasmā soṇo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.18.3: ‘khīṇā jāti. vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ. kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā”ti abbhaññāsi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.18.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā soṇo arahataṃ ahosi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.19.1: atha kho āyasmato soṇassa arahattappattassa etadahosi:
pli-tv-kd5:1.19.3: atha kho āyasmā soṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:1.19.4: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca.
pli-tv-kd5:1.20.1: “yo so bhante, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto, so cha ṭhānāni adhimutto hoti:
pli-tv-kd5:1.20.2: nekkhammādhimutto hoti. pavivekādhimutto hoti. abyāpajjhādhimutto hoti. upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti. taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti. asammohādhimutto hoti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.21.1: “siyā kho pana bhante idhekaccassa āyasmato evamassa:
pli-tv-kd5:1.21.2: ‘kevalaṃ saddhāmattakaṃ nūna ayamāyasmā nissāya nekkhammādhimutto’ti. na kho panetaṃ bhante, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.21.3: khīṇāsavo bhante, bhikkhu vusitavā, katakaraṇīyo karaṇīyamattānaṃ asamanupassanto katassa vā paticayaṃ, khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā nekkhammādhimutto hoti. khayā dosassa vītadosattā nekkhammādhimutto hoti. khayā mohassa vītamohattā nekkhammādhimutto hoti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.22.1: “siyā kho pana bhante, idhekaccassa āyasmato evamassa:
pli-tv-kd5:1.22.3: na kho panetaṃ bhante, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:1.22.4: khīṇāsavo bhante, bhikkhu vusitavā katakaraṇīyo karaṇīyamattano asamanupassanto katassa vā paticayaṃ, khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā pavivekādhimutto hoti. khayā dosassa vītadosattā pavivekādhimutto hoti. khayā mohassa vītamohattā pavivekādhimutto hoti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.23.1: “siyā kho pana bhante idhekaccassa āyasmato evamassa
pli-tv-kd5:1.23.4: khīṇāsavo bhante, bhikkhu vusitavā katakaraṇīyo karaṇīyamattano asamanupassanto katassa vā paticayaṃ, khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā abyāpajjhādhimutto hoti. khayā dosassa vītadosattā abyāpajjhādhimutto hoti. khayā mohassa vītamohattā abyāpajjhādhimutto hoti. …pe…
pli-tv-kd5:1.24.1: khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti. khayā dosassa vītadosattā upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti. khayā mohassa vītamohattā upādānakkhayādhimutto hoti. …pe…
pli-tv-kd5:1.24.2: khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti. khayā dosassa vītadosattā taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti. khayā mohassa vītamohattā taṇhakkhayādhimutto hoti. …pe…
pli-tv-kd5:1.24.3: khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā asammohādhimutto hoti. khayā dosassa vītadosattā asammohādhimutto hoti. khayā mohassa vītamohattā asammohādhimutto hoti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.25.1: “evaṃ sammā vimuttacittassa bhante, bhikkhuno bhusā cepi cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.25.2: amissīkatamevassa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ. vayañcassānupassati.
pli-tv-kd5:1.25.7: manoviññeyyā dhammā manassa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.25.8: amissīkatamevassa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ āneñjappattaṃ. vayañcassānupassati.
pli-tv-kd5:1.26.1: “seyyathāpi bhante, selo pabbato acchiddo asusiro ekagghano, puratthimāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi, neva naṃ saṅkampeyya. na sampakampeyya. na sampavedheyya.
pli-tv-kd5:1.26.2: pacchimāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi …pe…
pli-tv-kd5:1.26.3: uttarāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi …pe…
pli-tv-kd5:1.26.4: dakkhiṇāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi, neva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya. na sampavedheyya.
pli-tv-kd5:1.26.5: evameva kho bhante, evaṃ sammā vimuttacittassa bhikkhuno bhusā cepi cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti. nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti.
pli-tv-kd5:1.26.6: amissīkatamevassa cittaṃ hoti ṭhitaṃ ānejjappattaṃ. vayañcassānupassati.
pli-tv-kd5:1.26.11: manoviññeyyā dhammā manassa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti. nevassa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti.

pli-tv-kd5:10.1.5: “sāvatthiṃ kho ahaṃ āvuso, gamissāmi bhagavantaṃ dassanāyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.2.4: “alaṃ āvuso, paṭikkhittaṃ bhagavatā yānā”nti kukkuccāyanto yānaṃ nābhiruhi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.2.5: atha kho so bhikkhu sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.3.5: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno yānugghātena bāḷhataraṃ aphāsu ahosi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.4.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū uccāsayanamahāsayanāni dhārenti. seyyathidaṃ:
pli-tv-kd5:10.4.2: āsandiṃ pallaṅkaṃ goṇakaṃ cittakaṃ paṭikaṃ paṭalikaṃ tūlikaṃ vikatikaṃ uddalomiṃ ekantalomiṃ kaṭṭhissaṃ koseyyaṃ kuttakaṃ hatthattharaṃ assattharaṃ rathattharaṃ ajinappaveṇiṃ kādalimigapavarapaccattharaṇaṃ sauttaracchadaṃ ubhato lohitakūpadhānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:10.4.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti, khīyanti, vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd5:10.5.2: āsandi pallaṅko goṇako cittako paṭikā paṭalikā, tūlikā vikatikā uddhalomī ekantalomī kaṭṭhissaṃ, koseyyaṃ kuttakaṃ hatthattharaṃ assattharaṃ rathattharaṃ ajinappaveṇi kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇaṃ sauttaracchadaṃ ubhato lohitakūpadhānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:10.6.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd5:10.6.4: tāni mañcappamāṇenapi chinnāni honti. pīṭhappamāṇenapi chinnāni honti, antopi mañce paññattāni honti. bahipi mañce paññattāni honti. antopi pīṭhe paññattāni honti. bahipi pīṭhe paññattāni honti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.6.5: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti, khīyanti, vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd5:10.6.8: “na bhikkhave, mahācammāni dhāretabbāni: sīhacammaṃ byagghacammaṃ dīpicammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:10.7.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū
pli-tv-kd5:10.7.4: tāni mañcappamāṇenapi chinnāni honti. pīṭhappamāṇenapi chinnāni honti. antopi mañce paññattāni honti. bahipi mañce paññattāni honti. antopi pīṭhe paññattāni honti. bahipi pīṭhe paññattāni honti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.7.5: aññataropi pāpabhikkhu aññatarassa pāpūpāsakassa kulūpago hoti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.7.6: atha kho so pāpabhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena tassa pāpūpāsakassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.7.7: atha kho so pāpūpāsako yena so pāpabhikkhu tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā taṃ pāpabhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.8.1: tena kho pana samayena tassa pāpūpāsakassa vacchako hoti taruṇako abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko citro seyyathāpi dīpicchāpo.
pli-tv-kd5:10.8.2: atha kho so pāpabhikkhu taṃ vacchakaṃ sakkaccaṃ upanijjhāyati.
pli-tv-kd5:10.8.3: atha kho so pāpūpāsako taṃ pāpabhikkhuṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd5:10.8.4: “kissa bhante, ayyo imaṃ vacchakaṃ sakkaccaṃ upanijjhāyatī”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.8.6: atha kho so pāpūpāsako taṃ vacchakaṃ vadhitvā cammaṃ vidhunitvā tassa pāpabhikkhuno pādāsi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.8.7: atha kho so pāpabhikkhu taṃ cammaṃ saṅghāṭiyā paṭicchādetvā agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.1: atha kho sā gāvī vacchagiddhinī taṃ pāpabhikkhuṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.3: “kissa tyāyaṃ āvuso, gāvī piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddhā”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.4: “ahampi kho āvuso, na jānāmi kena myāyaṃ gāvī piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubaddhā”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.5: tena kho pana samayena tassa pāpabhikkhuno saṅghāṭi lohitena makkhitā hoti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.7: “ayaṃ pana te āvuso, saṅghāṭi kiṃ katā?”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.8: atha kho so pāpabhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.11: ye te bhikkhū appicchā, te ujjhāyanti, khīyanti, vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.12: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu pāṇātipāte samādapessati? nanu bhagavatā anekapariyāyena pāṇātipāto garahito? pāṇātipātā veramaṇī pasatthā”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:10.9.13: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:10.10.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā taṃ pāpabhikkhuṃ paṭipucchi.
pli-tv-kd5:10.10.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa, pāṇātipāte samādapessasi? nanu mayā, moghapurisa, anekapariyāyena pāṇātipāto garahito? pāṇātipātā veramaṇī pasatthā?
pli-tv-kd5:10.10.6: vigarahitvā dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd5:10.10.11: na ca bhikkhave, kiñci cammaṃ dhāretabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:11.1.1: tena kho pana samayena manussānaṃ mañcopi pīṭhampi cammonaddhāni honti cammavinaddhāni.
pli-tv-kd5:11.1.5: tena kho pana samayena vihārā cammavaṭṭehi ogumbīyanti.
pli-tv-kd5:12.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū saupāhanā gāmaṃ pavisanti.
pli-tv-kd5:12.1.7: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu gilāno hoti. na sakkoti vinā upāhanena gāmaṃ pavisituṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:12.1.9: “anujānāmi bhikkhave, gilānena bhikkhunā saupāhanena gāmaṃ pavisitu”nti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahākaccāyano avantīsu viharati kuraraghare papāte pabbate.
pli-tv-kd5:13.1.2: tena kho pana samayena soṇo upāsako kuṭikaṇṇo āyasmato mahākaccānassa upaṭṭhāko hoti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.1.3: atha kho soṇo upāsako kuṭikaṇṇo yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.1.4: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho soṇo, upāsako kuṭikaṇṇo āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd5:13.1.5: “yathā yathāhaṃ bhante, ayyena mahākaccānena dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ. ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.1.6: icchāmahaṃ bhante, kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.1: “dukkaraṃ kho soṇa, yāvajīvaṃ ekaseyyaṃ ekabhattaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.2: iṅgha tvaṃ soṇa , tattheva agārikabhūto buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ anuyuñja kālayuttaṃ ekaseyyaṃ ekabhattaṃ brahmacariya”nti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.3: atha kho soṇassa upāsakassa kuṭikaṇṇassa yo ahosi pabbajjābhisaṅkhāro, so paṭippassambhi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.5: tatiyampi kho soṇo upāsako kuṭikaṇṇo yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.6: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho soṇo upāsako kuṭikaṇṇo āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.7: “yathā yathāhaṃ bhante ayyena mahākaccāyanena dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi, nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.8: icchāmahaṃ bhante, kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.10: atha kho āyasmā mahākaccāno soṇaṃ upāsakaṃ kuṭikaṇṇaṃ pabbājesi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.11: tena kho pana samayena avantidakkhiṇāpatho appabhikkhuko hoti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.2.12: atha kho āyasmā mahākaccāno tiṇṇaṃ vassānaṃ accayena kicchena kasirena tato tato dasavaggaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ soṇaṃ upasampādesi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.3.1: atha kho āyasmato soṇassa vassaṃ vutthassa rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd5:13.3.2: “sutoyeva kho me so bhagavā ‘ediso ca ediso cā’ti. na ca mayā sammukhā diṭṭho. gaccheyyāhaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ, sace maṃ upajjhāyo anujāneyyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.3.3: atha kho āyasmā soṇo sāyaṇhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccāyanaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.4.1: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā soṇo āyasmantaṃ mahākaccāyanaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd5:13.4.2: “idha mayhaṃ bhante, rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
pli-tv-kd5:13.4.3: ‘sutoyeva kho me so bhagavā ‘ediso ca ediso cā’ti. na ca mayā sammukhā diṭṭho. gaccheyyāhaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ, sace maṃ upajjhāyo anujāneyyā’ti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.4.4: ‘gaccheyyāhaṃ bhante, taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ, sace maṃ upajjhāyo anujānātī”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.4.6: gaccha tvaṃ soṇa, taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ,
pli-tv-kd5:13.5.1: dakkhissasi tvaṃ soṇa taṃ bhagavantaṃ pāsādikaṃ pasādanīyaṃ santindriyaṃ santamānasaṃ uttamadamathasamathamanuppattaṃ dantaṃ guttaṃ yatindriyaṃ nāgaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.5.2: “tena hi tvaṃ soṇa, mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vanda
pli-tv-kd5:13.5.3: ‘upajjhāyo me bhante, āyasmā mahākaccāyano bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatī’ti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.5.5: ‘avantidakkhiṇāpatho bhante, appabhikkhuko. tiṇṇaṃ me vassānaṃ accayena kicchena kasirena tato tato dasavaggaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā upasampadaṃ alatthaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.5.6: appeva nāma bhagavā avantidakkhiṇāpathe appatarena gaṇena upasampadaṃ anujāneyyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.6.2: appeva nāma bhagavā avantidakkhiṇāpathe. gaṇaṅgaṇūpāhanaṃ anujāneyya.
pli-tv-kd5:13.6.4: appeva nāma bhagavā avantidakkhiṇāpathe dhuvanahānaṃ anujāneyya.
pli-tv-kd5:13.6.5: “avantidakkhiṇāpathe bhante, cammāni attharaṇāni eḷakacammaṃ ajacammaṃ migacammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.6.6: seyyathāpi bhante, majjhimesu janapadesu eragu moragu majjāru jantu,
pli-tv-kd5:13.6.7: evameva kho bhante, avantidakkhiṇāpathe cammāni attharaṇāni eḷakacammaṃ ajacammaṃ migacammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.6.8: appeva nāma bhagavā avantidakkhiṇāpathe cammāni attharaṇāni anujāneyya eḷakacammaṃ ajacammaṃ migacammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.7.1: “etarahi bhante, manussā nissīmagatānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cīvaraṃ denti:
pli-tv-kd5:13.7.4: ‘itthannāmehi te āvuso, manussehi cīvaraṃ dinna’nti te kukkuccāyantā na sādiyanti’
pli-tv-kd5:13.7.6: appeva nāma bhagavā cīvare pariyāyaṃ ācikkheyyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.7.8: kho āyasmā soṇo āyasmato mahākaccānassa paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena sāvatthi tena pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.8.1: anupubbena yena sāvatthi jetavanaṃ anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.8.2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd5:13.8.5: “yassa kho maṃ bhagavā āṇāpeti ‘imassa ānanda, āgantukassa bhikkhuno senāsanaṃ paññāpehī’ti, icchati bhagavā tena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ekavihāre vatthuṃ. icchati bhagavā āyasmatā soṇena saddhiṃ ekavihāre vatthu”nti
pli-tv-kd5:13.8.6: yasmiṃ vihāre bhagavā viharati, tasmiṃ vihāre āyasmato soṇassa senāsanaṃ paññāpesi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.9.1: atha kho bhagavā bahudeva rattiṃ ajjhokāse vītināmetvā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.9.2: āyasmāpi kho soṇo bahudeva rattiṃ ajjhokāse vītināmetvā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.9.3: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya āyasmantaṃ soṇaṃ ajjhesi:
pli-tv-kd5:13.9.5: “evaṃ bhante”ti kho āyasmā soṇo bhagavato paṭissuṇitvā sabbāneva aṭṭhakavaggikāni sarena abhāsi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.9.6: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato soṇassa sarabhaññapariyosāne abbhanumodi:
pli-tv-kd5:13.9.8: ‘suggahītāni kho te bhikkhu, aṭṭhakavaggikāni sumanasikatāni sūpadhāritāni.
pli-tv-kd5:13.9.9: kalyāṇiyāsi vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya, atthassa viññāpaniyā.
pli-tv-kd5:13.10.1: “kissa pana tvaṃ bhikkhu, evaṃ ciraṃ akāsī?”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.10.2: “ciradiṭṭho me bhante, kāmesu ādīnavo. api ca sambādhā gharāvāso bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.10.3: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.2: “paṭisammodati kho maṃ bhagavā. ayaṃ khvassa kālo yaṃ me upajjhāyo paridassī”ti
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.3: uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhagavato pāde sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.4: “upajjhāyo me bhante, āyasmā mahākaccāno bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati. evañca vadeti: “avantidakkhiṇāpatho bhante, appabhikkhuko.
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.5: tiṇṇaṃ me vassānaṃ accayena kicchena kasirena tato tato dasavaggaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā upasampadaṃ alatthaṃ. appeva nāma bhagavā avantidakkhiṇāpathe appatarena gaṇena upasampadaṃ anujāneyya.
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.7: appevanāma bhagavā avanti dakkhiṇāpathe guṇaṅgaṇūpāhanaṃ anujāneyya.
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.8: “avantidakkhiṇāpathe bhante, nahānagarukā manussā udakasuddhikā. appeva nāma bhagavā avantidakkhiṇāpathe dhuvanahānaṃ anujāneyya.
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.9: “avantidakkhiṇāpathe bhante, cammāni attharaṇāni: eḷakacammaṃ ajacammaṃ migacammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.10: seyyathāpi bhante, majjhimesu janapadesu eragu moragu majjāru jantu,
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.11: evameva kho bhante avantidakkhiṇāpathe cammāni attharaṇāni eḷakacammaṃ ajacammaṃ migacammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.12: appeva nāma bhagavā avantidakkhiṇāpathe cammāni attharaṇāni anujāneyya: eḷakacammaṃ ajacammaṃ migacammaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.13: “etarahi bhante, manussā nissīmagatānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cīvaraṃ denti:
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.19: appeva nāma bhagavā cīvare pariyāyaṃ ācikkheyyā”ti.
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.20: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe, dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi.
pli-tv-kd5:13.11.22: anujānāmi bhikkhave, sabbapaccantimesu janapadesu vinayadharapañcamena gaṇena upasampadaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.12.2: puratthimāya disāya kajaṅgalaṃ nāma nigamo. tassāparena mahāsālā. tato parā paccantimā janapadā. orato majjhe.
pli-tv-kd5:13.12.3: puratthimadakkhiṇāya disāya sallavatī nāma nadī. tato parā paccantimā janapadā. orato majjhe.
pli-tv-kd5:13.12.4: dakkhiṇāya disāya setakaṇṇikaṃ nāma nigamo. tato parā paccantimā janapadā. orato majjhe.
pli-tv-kd5:13.12.5: pacchimāya disāya thūṇaṃ nāma brāhmaṇagāmo. tato parā paccantimā janapadā, orato majjhe.
pli-tv-kd5:13.12.6: uttarāya disāya usīraddhajo nāma pabbato. tato parā paccantimā janapadā. orato majjhe.
pli-tv-kd5:13.12.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave, evarūpesu paccantimesu janapadesu vinayadharapañcamena gaṇena upasampadaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd5:13.13.5: “avantidakkhiṇāpathe bhikkhave, cammāni attharaṇāni: eḷakacammaṃ ajacammaṃ migacammaṃ
pli-tv-kd5:13.13.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, majjhimesu janapadesu eragu moragu majjāru jantu,
pli-tv-kd5:13.13.7: evameva kho bhikkhave, avantidakkhiṇāpathe cammāni attharaṇāni: eḷakacammaṃ ajacammaṃ migacammaṃ.
pli-tv-kd5:13.13.8: anujānāmi bhikkhave, sabbapaccantimesu janapadesu cammāni attharaṇāni: eḷakacammaṃ ajacammaṃ migacammaṃ.”
pli-tv-kd5:13.13.9: “idha pana bhikkhave, manussā nissīmagatānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cīvaraṃ denti:
pli-tv-kd5:13.13.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave, sādiyituṃ. na tāva taṃ gaṇanūpagaṃ yāva na hatthaṃ gacchatī”ti.
